user_intent.instructions: What primary financial action or service is the customer requesting?

criteria.check_balance: Check current checking, savings, or investment account balance and recent transactions.
criteria.approve_transfer: Authorize and execute a pending wire or fund transfer to a payee.
criteria.other: Ambiguous command, out-of-scope query, general inquiry, or noise.

high_stakes_risk.instructions: Does this request involve irreversible fund movement or high monetary exposure?

criteria.true: Involves executing an outgoing financial payment, wire, or transfer.
criteria.false: Read-only balance inspection or low-stakes informational inquiry.

final_destination_route.instructions: Which execution or gating path should be triggered based on calibrated confidence thresholds?

criteria.display_balance: Auto-Display Balance - Low-stakes read-only operation executed immediately.
criteria.approve_transfer_direct: Direct Auto-Approval - High-stakes transfer with exceptional confidence (>= 0.85).
criteria.confirm_transfer_user: Require User Verbal/2FA Confirmation - High-stakes transfer with moderate confidence (0.60 - 0.85).
criteria.human_escalation: Escalate to Human Support Specialist - Low confidence (< 0.60) or ambiguous intent.
